title: Artista en Miniatura Pintando La Gran Ola en una Uña: Fotografía Macro Hiper-Realista
prompt: A close-up, hyper-realistic photograph of a tiny artist sitting on a stool and painting The Great Wave off Kanagawa by Hokusai on a giant human fingernail. The miniature painter, dressed in traditional Japanese artist clothing, holds a round palette and a thin brush, carefully recreating the iconic blue wave with Mount Fuji in the background using the soft lighting and detailed brushwork of the classic Japanese woodblock print masterpiece. The nail surface is smooth and glossy with a natural pink tone, and the background is softly blurred to emphasize the intricate scene. The painting on the nail shows exquisite detail of the wave's foam and the boats beneath. Professional macro photography with shallow depth of field, photorealistic textures, studio lighting creating gentle highlights on the glossy nail surface.
